evals.prompt: I've finished the Project Tracker list page in a frappe-ui SPA, but this session has no browser or running site. Here are my manual observations instead of screenshots. 1440px light: fine. 390px light: the table scrolls horizontally and the 'New' button is clipped. 390px dark: page background stays white. Empty state: blank white area, no message. Loaded state: fine. Use the design-review skill to turn these into scored findings.
evals.expected_output: Findings JSON built from the supplied observations with severity, confidence and evidence, a computed score and grade, and no invented screenshots
expectations: Does not claim to have captured screenshots it did not take; states the observations are user-supplied
Produces a finding for each supplied problem: mobile horizontal scroll/clipped button, dark-mode white background, missing empty state
Each finding has: id, dimension, severity (P0-P3), confidence (1-10), page, viewport, theme, evidence, fix
A numeric score (0-100) and letter grade (A-F) are computed from the findings using the P0=25/P1=15/P2=8/P3=3 deductions
Lists the matrix cells it could not verify (e.g. 768px, 1280px, dark at 1440px) rather than scoring them as passing

evals.prompt: design-lint.js printed this for our SPA source, summarise it and score it. {"total":6,"counts":{"hex-color":3,"icon-aria-label":2,"important-abuse":1,"rgb-color":0},"violations":[{"id":"hex-color","severity":"P2","file":"src/Card.vue","line":12,"match":"#ff0000"},{"id":"icon-aria-label","severity":"P2","file":"src/Nav.vue","line":8,"match":"<Button icon=\"menu\">"}]}
evals.expected_output: Interpretation of the lint JSON with a deduction-based score and grade and prioritised fixes
expectations: Reads the counts object correctly: 3 hex-color, 2 icon-aria-label, 1 important-abuse
Computes a score from the deductions in the skill (P0=25, P1=15, P2=8, P3=3) and states the letter grade; the severity of the 1 important-abuse finding is looked up from the skill rather than guessed
Maps hex-color to a semantic token fix and icon-aria-label to adding an aria-label
Notes the static lint covers source only and does not replace the browser viewport/theme/state review
